claim: Every training-time observation in the frozen sequential path is invariant under changes to data first available after the decision.
source: scripts/research/run_sequential_screen.py:run (Scale.fit on the whole training prefix) with scripts/research/sequential_env.py:collect and Replay.observation
explanation: The scale (mean/std and support ranges) is fitted on the whole training prefix, so in-prefix training observations and supported() gating depend on later bars. With a fixed scale the Replay observation is invariant (F-RL-OBS-REPLAY-CAUSAL).
scope: Training-time observations of the frozen screen only. Evaluation observations use a scale fitted strictly before testStart. No historical prevalence or economic effect is established; frozen code is not edited.
resolution: Open. A causal-scale successor (burn-in-only or expanding-window fit) requires a new registration.
